short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Lynwood.
local_note: Lynwood homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Lynwood's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Lynwood, including Lynwood proper, Compton adjacent, South Gate adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Lynwood?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Lynwood building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Lynwood?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Lynwood rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Lynwood remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
